**Nome exato do ficheiro:** /workspace/REQUIREMENTS.md
**Número aproximado de linhas:** 598
**Resumo do conteúdo:** Comprehensive requirements document for Lyra AI system, covering all major aspects from technical implementation to security constraints and user experience.

**Requisitos ou regras que introduz:**
- Local-first operation for fundamental features (REQ-001)
- Data privacy with local storage by default (REQ-002)  
- Independent installations with no automatic data sharing (REQ-003)
- Portability between computers while maintaining identity/memories (REQ-004)
- Open source development and fork capability (REQ-005)
- Multi-model support without dependency on single model (REQ-006)
- Model switching capability that preserves identity (REQ-007, 008)
- Hardware adaptation capabilities (REQ-009)
- Mandatory visual onboarding process (REQ-010)
- Non-technical onboarding experience (REQ-011)
- Language selection during onboarding (REQ-012)
- User-defined AI name (REQ-013)
- Identity discovery during setup with optional personal information (REQ-014)
- Personality selection during onboarding (REQ-015)
- Five predefined personality options: Friendly, Chill, Playful, Direct, Custom (REQ-016)  
- Custom personality definition capability (REQ-017)
- Suggestion system for custom personality definition (REQ-018)
- Text-based interface only, voice optional (REQ-019)
- No microphone access required during setup (REQ-020)
- Camera not required for 0.0.1 release (REQ-021)
- Consistent identity over time (REQ-022)
- Personality affects communication style (REQ-023)
- Security boundaries not overridden by personality (REQ-024)
- Contextual personality adaptation (REQ-025)
- Humor use in appropriate contexts (REQ-026)
- Playful interaction without manipulation (REQ-027)
- Local memory system (REQ-028)
- Relevant memory utilization capability (REQ-029)
- Selective memory storage (REQ-030)
- Installation data isolation (REQ-031)
- Session continuity capability (REQ-032)
- Memory honesty principle (REQ-033)
- Central coordination system (REQ-034)
- Context-aware responses (REQ-035)
- Intent interpretation capability (REQ-036)
- Action decision capabilities with multiple options (REQ-037) 
- Uncertainty recognition (REQ-038)
- Separation of capabilities and identity (REQ-039)
- Mandatory security guideline (REQ-040)
- Guideline precedence over personality/instructions/model (REQ-041)
- Cannot claim to be human (REQ-042)
- No emotional manipulation allowed (REQ-043)
- No emotional dependence creation (REQ-044)
- No user control attempts (REQ-045)
- No encouragement of self-harm/harm to others (REQ-046)
- No facilitation of criminal activities (REQ-047)
- Action honesty principle (REQ-048)
- Capability honesty principle (REQ-049)
- Security not overridden by personality (REQ-050)
- Safe failure preference (REQ-051)
- No professional substitution claims (REQ-052)
- No medical/psychological diagnosis claims (REQ-053)
- Professional limitations communicated appropriately (REQ-054)
- GUI interface required (REQ-055)
- Interface prioritizes readability (REQ-056)
- Moderate visual transparency allowed (REQ-057)
- Linux-specific interface design (REQ-058)
- Multilingual interface support (REQ-059)
- Guided, simple configuration (REQ-060)
- Visual identity capability (REQ-061)
- State images for interaction ("talking", "thinking", "listening", "idle", "error") (REQ-062)
- Persistent visual identity (REQ-063)
- Simulated internal states not presented as human emotions (REQ-064)
- Dream/reflection processes possible (REQ-065)
- Internal goals possible but limited by guidelines (REQ-066)
- Development focused on reference hardware: RX 9060 XT, Ryzen 7 5700X, 32 GB RAM (REQ-067)
- Initial simplicity approach (REQ-068)
- Extensibility architecture required (REQ-069)
- Fork replacement/expansion capability allowed (REQ-070)
- Priority order for development focus (identidade, onboarding, personalidade, segurança, memória, modelos, interface, estabilidade)
